integrity: All numerical claims are accompanied by finite dyadic interval certificates and an analytic global remainder bound. No external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Rigorous exponential rate and asymptotic prefactor are proved for the stationary moment sequence, not for a pointwise density tail or dynamical relaxation. Mean-field stationary moment equation is assumed from the cited model.
title: Exact dyadic constants and square-root moments for equal-half aggregation–fragmentation
